en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet, straight city street lined with ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century multi‑story buildings on both sides. At the far end of the street there are trees. A few pedestrians are visible, including a child standing in the middle of the street and an adult on the right sidewalk. Shopfronts with signage occupy the ground floors, including a corner shop with decorative lettering. At the top of the image is the printed caption "GRAZ Westgasse."
